recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical 1970s-style album cover featuring two distinct portrait panels enclosed in a single continuous orange-to-purple gradient border with ornate flourishes. The portraits are warm-toned, grainy photographs of a male and female subject, set against a dark, textured background with prominent inline display typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Continuous flowing border connecting top and bottom text
Warm, low-contrast photographic subjects against a dark field
Harmonious relationship between the inline font style and the curved border flourishes
coreInvariants: Ornate scroll-like flourishes at the corners of the text blocks
Muted, warm color palette with heavy grain

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two medium close-up portraits side-by-side, occupying the central 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central vertical divide between the two portrait frames.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top text leads to the left portrait, then right portrait, finishing at the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial dark border area surrounding the central framed elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm sepia and tan tones in the photography
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted orange and lavender in the border lines
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value contrast between the light subjects and dark background.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones and muted pastels

letterConstructionRules: Prominent internal inline or double-line effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: Inline follows the path of the outer stroke exactly
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both top and bottom text to maintain symmetry.

candidateDirections.reason: Clean geometric skeleton with internal line

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark, textured 1970s album cover background. In the center, place two side-by-side vertical rectangular frames with rounded corners. Inside the left frame, a warm-toned, grainy portrait of a blonde woman in a dark lace dress. Inside the right frame, a warm-toned, grainy portrait of a man with dark curly hair in a dark shirt. Surround the frames with a thin, double-lined orange and lavender border that includes ornate scroll flourishes at the top and bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase inline sans-serif text centered at the top and bottom, positioned between the scroll flourishes of the border.

verificationChecks: Are the portraits grainy and warm-toned?
Is the border continuous with the flourishes?
Does the text have an internal inline effect?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
Exact wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the inline font is legible and centered
Verify the border flourishes are mirrored correctly
Confirm the color palette remains in the sepia/earth-tone range
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical dual-frame layout + 70s film grain + Inline display typography + Ornate line-art border.
